title: An answered card tightens at once, not only off screen
why: shiv, Oct 30 15:06 CDT (waiting-page comment): 'why is this green area still so large after submitting a question, yet often it's started fixing where it correctly tightens? just not always?' Read on main page.html (releaseHeld, heldWatch): after Send a card keeps its old height (minHeight held) so nothing in view moves, and drops it only once wholly off screen with the scroll idle. A card still in view stays tall, so it looks random.
note: Built rule (lane receipt-tightens-at-once, PR #880, batch 37; coordinator 2's rewrite, Oct 30 17:26 CDT, can be undone): only Send tightens an answered card at once; the first card under the sticky header holds its place on screen (not the next card: holding the next card measured +456 px and +624 px jumps). Other ways a card turns answered keep today's rule: hold the height while in view, drop it once off screen. Done check: send an item mid-screen; its card shrinks within one frame and the first card under the header does not move. Needs no answer. Port: every repo with a waiting page.
